selection_rule.primary: smallest subset within fixed validation tolerance
selection_rule.secondary: smallest subset within one seed-level standard error

notes: All 1023 non-empty A10 subsets are enumerated; subsets with no action at or below budget are infeasible.
Ridge alpha selection and action-library selection use disjoint validation prompts.
Subset choice uses validation only; test truth enters only after the subset is frozen.
GM and AM share embeddings and splits but use independent Ridge score heads.
The fixed-prefix A8 result is retained only as a reference and is not used for selection.
